core_obligations: If B1 is rig-smooth over (A1, I1), then the base change B2 is rig-smooth over (A2, I2).

proof_roadmap: Transfer the Ext^1 annihilation property from B1 to B2 via the persistence lemma.
Use the definition of rig-smooth homomorphisms and the commensurability of I2 with I1 A2 to conclude.
